content: Suppose I am looking at an infix symbol in VS Code. Is there a straightforward way to find out its binding strength? (I know that set_option pp.parens true will help uncover relative strength.)
It's not super straightforward but #help term "∘" will show a clickable «term_∘_» on the first line of the infoview, which you can then click on to see infixr:90
